UnityVolumetricCloudsURP
https://github.com/jiaozi158/UnityVolumetricCloudsURP

Heritage Engine CLOUDURP01/VCLOUD01 includes a Heritage-native OpenGL/GLSL adaptation of volumetric-cloud density, lighting, ray-integration and shadow techniques based on this MIT-licensed project. Unity/URP integration code is not used directly.
